name: changenet-data-prepare
description: Prepare CSV annotations for Visual ChangeNet training from paired defect/golden image directories. Normalizes filenames (adds light suffix), converts PNG to JPG, and generates 4-column CSV (input_path, golden_path, label, object_name).

root-folder.description: Root folder prefix for CSV path columns

label.description: Force single label for all rows (auto-detected if omitted)
